title: Open now: marked only from known hours, in the place's own time; everything else says Hours not known
why: P10, reopened by Jason 2026-11-27 ("Open now is marked and filtered only where hours are known (the owner's or OpenStreetMap's). Everything else says 'hours not known', never a guess"); the launch plan's C.8; the CEO's brief (the results that ask for open now say how many have known hours; the listing's own zone). One helper, app/lib/OpenNow.php, holds the rules search, Get Local and the hub share: hours are known when the owner or our staff entered them (entity_metadata source_type owner or admin, or locked) or OpenStreetMap gave them (a current hours fact with an openstreetmap.org source); open or closed is worked out in the place's own time zone (CLAUDE.md "Times where they happened"), never the visitor's clock. Search's index keeps only known hours (re-read once for every listing with hours, 600 a run); hours read from a website still show on the listing's page but never make it open or closed. An open-now (or open-on-a-day) search or Get Local list shows the known-open first, then the places whose hours aren't known, each marked "Hours not known" (it was "Hours not listed"), leaves out those known to be closed, and says "N of M have known hours". The hub's cards say Open now, Closed now or Hours not known on the same rules. Found while testing: search's "Open" tag shared the class of the header's search button (.tvs-open), so it was hidden on a computer and drawn as the 38px search pill on a phone; the tag now has its own class (.tvs-isopen) with the tag's own style. Settled by the team under P10's ruling (the session manager, 2026-11-27, 04:43 UTC; none is a Founder ruling, each applies his "known hours only"): (a) hours our staff entered count as known: they come from the business like the owner's and are locked against the crawler; (b) on an open-now search the places with hours not known stay, labelled, after the known-open ones, on search and Get Local alike, with the count: nothing hidden for lack of data; (c) Navajo Nation land in Arizona keeps daylight time (America/Denver), and the Hopi Reservation inside it keeps Arizona time (America/Phoenix): the nation is checked, not only the outer line (Nations::allAt). FAQ: a new answer "What does Hours not known mean?", and the guide answer that said the crawler's hours decide open now made true. No new tables, no outside calls, no cost.

changes.what: Search "pizza open now" with a place: the known-open first, marked Open; the rest marked Hours not known; "N of M have known hours"
Get Local with Open now on: the known-open first, then Hours not known; "N of M have known hours" over the list
A hub's business cards: Open now, Closed now or Hours not known
FAQ: What does Hours not known mean?
